d:
Want to suggest a guest?
Awais Ahmed is the founder and CEO of Pixxel, the Bangalore startup building hyperspectral satellites that can spot a dying crop or an oil spill invisible to the human eye. Pixxel builds its satellites in India and sells the data worldwide, including to NASA and the US National Reconnaissance Office. Its new US subsidiary, Pixxel Federal, set off online accusations that the company is controlled by the CIA. We met him days later, inside Pixxel HQ. He answers every charge on the record.
